title: McMoneagle tasked to remote view Mars a million years ago

tellings.quote: psychic spy program and he was given this is now public and declassified he was given coordinates to remote view on Mars a million years in the past. Yes.

plain: In the 1980s, a man named Joe McMoneagle, who worked in a US government psychic spy program, is said to have been given coordinates and asked to remote view, that is, to perceive a distant place with the mind alone, the planet Mars as it was a million years in the past. Michels tells it himself and says the tasking is now public and declassified, which, if so, would mean the government took the idea of ancient Mars seriously enough to send a psychic there.
